last.verdict: Solid beat on sales and profit; shares rose despite a rich valuation.

reasons.label: Beat on estimates
reasons.text: Earnings of $6.75 a share and $95.7B revenue topped forecasts of about $6.54 and $94.9B.

reasons.label: Strong underlying sales
reasons.text: Sales at stores open a year rose 6.7% excluding gas and currency, with traffic up 3.3%.

reasons.label: Tariff refunds passed on
reasons.text: $184M in refunds added $0.15 a share, but most is going back to members as lower prices.

story: Costco has kept posting steady sales gains and beats, with gas lifting reported sales. The stock trades at a high multiple, about 46 times earnings. After the May report it fell about 4% despite record revenue. This time it rose.
